title: Anchorage Digital buys B2B payments automation startup Routable for an undisclosed sum; Anchorage CEO calls it its largest acquisition by team size and revenue (Ryan Lawler/Axios)
summary: Ryan Lawler / Axios: Anchorage Digital buys B2B payments automation startup Routable for an undisclosed sum; Anchorage CEO calls it its largest acquisition by team size and revenue — Anchorage Digital has acquired Routable, a startup that helps businesses automate payouts to vendors, contractors and other recipients …
